skills.trigger: When evaluating a posterior mediastinal mass on CT to differentiate between neurogenic tumors such as neuroblastoma and ganglioneuroma.
steps: Assess the internal texture and enhancement pattern of the mass, specifically looking for heterogeneity versus homogeneity.
Analyze the morphology of any intratumoral calcifications, distinguishing between fine/stippled patterns and coarse/clumped patterns.
Correlate findings: Heterogeneous enhancement with fine, stippled calcifications suggests neuroblastoma, whereas homogeneous enhancement with coarse calcifications suggests ganglioneuroma.
